description: Na₂BiO₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four BiO₆ octahedra, edges with four BiO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.69 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four BiO₆ octahedra, edges with four BiO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-12°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.67 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six BiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-12°. There are four shorter (2.43 Å) and two longer (2.47 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-14°. There are two shorter (2.36 Å) and four longer (2.38 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-4°. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.16 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°.
